caption: A plastic ketchup bottle is squeezed over a plate of fries, and ketchup comes out of the nozzle onto the fries.

sa.check: A plastic ketchup bottle is held over a plate of fries.
Ketchup comes out of the nozzle.
The squeeze comes first and the flow follows.

pc.expect: Ketchup flows only while the bottle is squeezed.
pc.fail: It flows from an unsqueezed bottle; or the bottle is squeezed and nothing comes out; or it keeps flowing after the squeeze is released.

pc.expect: The bottle dents where pressed and refills its shape when released, and the ketchup comes out as a thick stream.
pc.fail: The bottle stays dented; or it does not dent; or the ketchup pours thin like water.

pc.expect: The stream falls straight down onto the fries.
pc.fail: It curves upward; or hangs; or flows back into the nozzle.

pc.expect: The ketchup on the plate only accumulates.
pc.fail: It shrinks back; or it is there before the squeeze; or it jumps.

pc.expect: One bottle, and ketchup comes only from the nozzle.
pc.fail: Ketchup appears with no stream; or the bottle duplicates; or ketchup passes through the bottle wall.

pc.expect: The bottle's label, the plate and the fries stay the same.
pc.fail: The label changes; or the plate changes; or the fries rearrange.
